level.setting: A sunken ancient city shrouded in bioluminescent algae, with crumbling stone pillars, overgrown coral structures, and eerie glowing symbols etched into the walls. Strange, low-frequency hums echo through the water, hinting at dormant power.
level.player_weapon: Geode Staff (channels seismic energy, unleashes shockwaves, and manipulates terrain)

enemy.name: Coral Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Geode Staff's shockwave ability

encounters.hazard: Collapsing coral pillars triggered by seismic activity

pickup.name: Tidal Crystal
pickup.effect: Increases Geode Staff's shockwave radius by 50% and temporarily hardens the terrain against enemy attacks

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Leviathan causes the coral barriers to shift, revealing a hidden path to the next area.

enemy.name: Submersible Drone
enemy.weakness: Tidal Crystal (disrupts energy shields)

encounters.hazard: Laser grids and pressure-sensitive traps

pickup.name: Ancient Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the boss's core vulnerability; can be used to target weak points

encounters.trigger: Destroying the drone's shields with the Tidal Crystal activates a mechanism that opens the sealed boss chamber.

boss.name: Abyssal Guardian
boss.victory_condition: Use the Ancient Key to target the core, then strike with a charged Geode Staff shockwave

level.objective: Navigate the ruins, defeat the guardians, and unlock the sealed chamber to confront the Abyssal Guardian. The environment reacts to your actions, with each victory altering the path forward.
level.reward: Echo of the Deep (permanent ability: summon a seismic wave that deals damage and stuns enemies)

level.setting: A tranquil underwater reef teeming with vibrant marine life, glowing anemones, and gentle currents. The environment is designed to feel peaceful but gradually shifts toward tension as the player progresses.

enemy.name: Serrated Eel
enemy.weakness: Harpoon Gun (player's primary weapon)

encounters.hazard: None

pickup.name: Coral Shard
pickup.effect: Unlocks access to hidden underwater caves by disrupting sand traps.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the eel, the sand shifts, revealing a hidden cave entrance.

enemy.name: Luminous Jellyfish
enemy.weakness: Coral Shard (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Sticky bioluminescent goo that slows movement

pickup.name: Bioluminescent Orb
pickup.effect: Emits light to reveal hidden paths and weaken dark-favored enemies.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the jellyfish, the orb illuminates a path to the Abyssal Trench.

enemy.name: Guardian Octopus
enemy.weakness: Bioluminescent Orb (pickup from second encounter)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing rock formations, strong currents

pickup.name: Pearl of Serenity
pickup.effect: Restores 50% health and temporarily calms nearby enemies.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the octopus with the orb reveals the pearl, completing the level.

boss.name: Guardian Octopus
boss.weakness: Bioluminescent Orb (specific pickup from second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss by targeting its core with the orb's light.

level.objective: Navigate the reef, defeat three enemies, and use collected pickups to overcome the final boss while maintaining the serene atmosphere.
level.reward: Pearl of Serenity (healing item), +10% Beastmaster companion affinity

level.setting: A sunken, ancient temple in the Hadal Zone, where bioluminescent algae coat crumbling stone pillars and the water is thick with silt. The air hums with the distant groans of shifting rock, and the player’s necromancy powers are amplified by the eerie energy of the depths. The environment is claustrophobic, with narrow corridors and collapsed chambers that force the player to navigate treacherous terrain.
level.player_weapon: Bone Staff of the Forsaken (deals necrotic damage, can summon skeletal minions)

enemy.name: Abyssal Warden
enemy.weakness: Necrotic damage (player's Bone Staff)

encounters.hazard: The Warden is surrounded by a crystalline barrier that only cracks when the player lands 3 consecutive necrotic hits. This requires precise aiming.

pickup.name: Tidal Core
pickup.effect: Allows the Bone Staff to channel necrotic energy into electrical discharges (increases damage by 50% against conductive enemies).

encounters.trigger: Destroy the Warden's barrier by landing 3 necrotic hits to unlock a submerged passage to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Undead Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Electrical damage (requires Tidal Core from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The Leviathan's tentacles summon whirlpools that pull the player into the abyss, dealing 30 damage per second.

pickup.name: Void Essence
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ability to summon a 'Bone Colossus' (a temporary, powerful undead construct) that deals 200 damage on impact.

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Leviathan to break the chains binding the temple’s central chamber, revealing the boss’s lair.

boss.name: Abyssal Sovereign
boss.weakness: Void Essence (required to summon Bone Colossus)
boss.victory_condition: Use the Bone Colossus to shatter the Sovereign’s crystalline core, while avoiding its tidal wave attacks that knock the player back and drain 50% of their health.

level.objective: Navigate the temple, defeat the three guardians, and exploit their weaknesses to claim the Void Essence for the final confrontation.
level.reward: Abyssal Crown (increases necrotic damage by 30% and grants immunity to drowning)

level.setting: Abyssal Crucible - A collapsing trench filled with bioluminescent flora, jagged rock formations, and crushing pressure. Visibility is limited, and currents shift unpredictably.
level.player_weapon: Stormcaller's Lightning Staff - A conduit for channeling electrical energy, capable of discharging shocks or creating localized storms.

encounters.location: Narrow Trench of the Eel King

enemy.name: Bioluminescent Eel
enemy.weakness: Player's Lightning Staff (direct electrical discharges to its tail)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing rocks and low oxygen zones

pickup.name: Conductive Core
pickup.effect: Amplifies the Stormcaller's weapon damage by 30% when equipped.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Eel opens a path through a collapsing rock formation, revealing the crystalline cave ahead.

enemy.name: Crystalline Coral Golem
enemy.weakness: Conductive Core (absorb and redirect energy to cause a short-circuit)

encounters.hazard: Reflected lightning attacks that damage the player on contact

pickup.name: Tidal Lens
pickup.effect: Allows manipulation of water currents to create whirlpools or reveal hidden paths.

encounters.trigger: Using the Tidal Lens to redirect a deadly current opens the final gate to the boss chamber.

boss.name: Leviathan of the Abyss
boss.weakness: Combined use of Conductive Core and Tidal Lens (create a shockwave through a whirlpool)
boss.victory_condition: Channel a charged electric current through a whirlpool to penetrate the Leviathan's conductive armor.

level.objective: Navigate the trench, acquire the Conductive Core and Tidal Lens, and use them to defeat the Leviathan in the final chamber.
level.reward: Stormcaller's Tempest Amulet - Grants temporary invulnerability during lightning discharges.

level.setting: A derelict underwater research facility, illuminated by erratic bioluminescent algae. Murky waters, creaking metal corridors, and distant, unsettling clicks create an oppressive atmosphere.
level.player_weapon: Shadowblade (can channel light energy or disrupt electronics)

enemy.name: Void Eel
enemy.weakness: Light-based attacks (player's shadowblade can emit a concentrated light pulse).

encounters.hazard: Murky water reduces visibility; Void Eel merges with shadows to ambush the player.

pickup.name: Bioluminescent Core
pickup.effect: Emits a steady light to pierce darkness, temporarily revealing hidden paths and weakening shadow-based enemies.

encounters.trigger: The player activates a nearby console, disturbing the Void Eel and triggering the fight.

enemy.name: Glowscythe
enemy.weakness: Light exposure (use Bioluminescent Core from prior encounter to blind the creature).

encounters.hazard: The Glowscythe's carapace reflects sonar pulses, creating disorienting echoes.

pickup.name: Sonar Pulse Device
pickup.effect: Disrupts enemy sensors and reveals hidden weaknesses; can bypass the boss's shield.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Void Eel, the Bioluminescent Core unlocks a sealed hatch, leading to the Glowscythe's lair.

enemy.name: Abyssal Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Sonar Pulse Device (from prior encounter) disrupts its protective shield, allowing the shadowblade to penetrate.

encounters.hazard: The Leviathan's presence causes structural collapse; debris falls from the ceiling during the fight.

pickup.name: Abyssal Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the facility's upper levels, granting access to a safe zone and ending the level.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Glowscythe's carapace sends a shockwave that awakens the Leviathan, which emerges from the facility's core chamber.

boss.name: Abyssal Leviathan
boss.weakness: Sonar Pulse Device (acquired in Encounter 2) to bypass its shield.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Leviathan while avoiding collapsing debris and maintaining the Sonar Pulse Device's charge.

level.objective: Navigate the facility, retrieve pickups, and defeat the Leviathan to escape the collapsing structure.
level.reward: Abyssal Key (unlocks next level) and 150 experience points.

level.setting: A collapsing bioluminescent cave system filled with shifting currents, unstable rock formations, and toxic plumes. The environment reacts to combat, triggering tremors and sudden pressure surges that hinder movement.
level.player_weapon: Pyroclastic Torch (initial weapon: emits controlled fireballs, but struggles in water unless augmented)

enemy.name: Thermophobe Jelly
enemy.weakness: Pyroclastic Torch (direct fire damage bypasses its gelatinous armor)

encounters.hazard: After defeating the jelly, the cave's unstable ceiling collapses, triggering a pressure surge that awakens the next enemy.

pickup.name: Oxygen Canister
pickup.effect: Allows the Pyroclastic Torch to ignite underwater for 15 seconds, dealing 50% more damage.

encounters.trigger: The pressure surge from the collapse activates the second encounter.

enemy.name: Hydropressurizer
enemy.weakness: Oxygen Canister (when used, it overloads the enemy's pressure core, creating a shockwave that damages it)

encounters.hazard: The enemy's core emits a corrosive mist that reduces the player's torch effectiveness by 30% over time.

pickup.name: Corrosive Solution
pickup.effect: Can be mixed with the Oxygen Canister to create an explosive reaction (available during the boss fight).

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Hydropressurizer destabilizes the cave's foundation, revealing the final boss chamber.

enemy.name: Abyssal Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Combination of Corrosive Solution and Oxygen Canister (creates an explosion that bypasses its armor)

encounters.hazard: The boss periodically summons fire-resistant tentacles that must be destroyed with the Corrosive Solution before the final attack.

pickup.name: Pyro-Adaptive Gauntlet
pickup.effect: Permanently boosts fire damage by 25% and grants immunity to the boss's toxic mist.

encounters.trigger: The player must collect both pickups from prior encounters to activate the boss's fatal weakness.

boss.name: Abyssal Leviathan
boss.weakness: Explosive reaction from Corrosive Solution + Oxygen Canister (triggered by mixing them in the boss's core during phase 2)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core with the explosive reaction, then land a final fireball while wearing the Pyro-Adaptive Gauntlet.

level.objective: Navigate the collapsing cave, defeat three enemies to unlock the boss, and exploit environmental pickups to overcome the final challenge.
level.reward: Pyro-Adaptive Gauntlet and access to deeper underwater zones.

level.setting: A sunken, abandoned research facility shrouded in perpetual darkness, with bioluminescent algae casting eerie blue light over corroded metal and overgrown coral. The water is thick with sediment, reducing visibility, and the hum of distant machinery echoes through the ruins.
level.player_weapon: Plasma Reaver (a heavy-duty plasma cannon with an overheat mode that releases a sustained thermal blast)

enemy.name: Wraith Eel Swarm
enemy.weakness: Thermal damage (triggered by the Plasma Reaver's overheat mode)

encounters.hazard: Murky water reduces player movement speed by 25%.

pickup.name: Thermal Core (Type-A)
pickup.effect: Overloads mechanical systems or weakens heat-resistant enemies when deployed.

encounters.trigger: The player must navigate the trench, provoking the eels by disturbing their nest. Defeating them unlocks the Thermal Core and reveals a sealed corridor ahead.

enemy.name: Guardian Drone (Sentinel-7)
enemy.weakness: Thermal Core (Type-A) deployment

encounters.hazard: The drone's laser grid forces the player to dodge constantly, dealing 50 damage per second if stationary.

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: Defeating the drone removes its barrier, granting access to the final chamber.

encounters.trigger: The Thermal Core is required to overload the drone's power core. Upon destruction, the floor collapses, revealing the boss arena.

enemy.name: Leviathan of the Abyss
enemy.weakness: Thermal Core (Type-A) + Plasma Reaver's overheat mode (combined)

encounters.hazard: The leviathan's tail swipes create whirlpools, pulling the player into the abyss for 3 seconds (dealing 200 damage).

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: Defeating the leviathan grants the player a temporary buff: 'Abyssal Resolve' (increased armor by 30% for 60 seconds).

encounters.trigger: The leviathan awakens after the drone's destruction. The player must use the Thermal Core to melt its armored hide, exposing its core to the Plasma Reaver's attacks.

boss.name: Leviathan of the Abyss
boss.weakness: Thermal Core (Type-A) + Plasma Reaver's overheat mode (combined)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the leviathan's core by combining Thermal Core deployment with sustained plasma fire.

level.objective: Clear the facility of threats and survive the leviathan's wrath. The Thermal Core is essential for progressing and defeating the final boss.
level.reward: Abyssal Resolve buff, and the player gains access to a new weapon upgrade: 'Plasma Reaver Overheat Protocol' (increased thermal damage by 50% for 10 seconds).

level.setting: A vibrant underwater realm filled with bioluminescent coral, playful schools of fish, and floating islands of kelp. The environment shifts with illusions, creating a dreamlike atmosphere.
level.player_weapon: Illusion Wand (creates light, sound, and mirage-based attacks)

enemy.name: Glittering Jellyfish
enemy.weakness: Light illusions (player's Illusion Wand)

encounters.hazard: Stinging tentacles that cause temporary blindness.

pickup.name: Prismatic Crystal
pickup.effect: Amplifies light-based illusions by 50% for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: The jellyfish's distraction allows the player to unlock a hidden coral passage leading to the kelp labyrinth.

enemy.name: Mimic (Coral Shapeshifter)
enemy.weakness: Sound illusions (player's Illusion Wand)

encounters.hazard: The mimic mimics the player's movements, forcing them to solve a timing puzzle to avoid being trapped.

pickup.name: Echo Bell
pickup.effect: Creates a resonant soundwave that disrupts enemy magic for 5 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the mimic, the Echo Bell activates a hidden switch, revealing the path to the Guardian's Chamber.

enemy.name: Territorial Guardian (Giant Lobster)
enemy.weakness: Prismatic Crystal (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The lobster throws weighted shells that create whirlpools.

pickup.name: Pearl of Clarity
pickup.effect: Restores 2 health and grants a 10-second invincibility shield.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the lobster with the Prismatic Crystal unlocks a glowing path to the boss fight, the Sea Serpent Queen.

boss.name: Sea Serpent Queen
boss.victory_condition: Use the Echo Bell to disrupt the serpent's illusions and strike its core during a 3-second window when its defenses are lowered.

level.objective: Navigate the whimsical underwater realm, using illusions and pickups to overcome playful enemies and defeat the Sea Serpent Queen.
level.reward: The player gains a permanent ability: 'Mirage Surge,' which summons a temporary whirlpool to slow enemies for 5 seconds.

level.setting: A dense, overgrown rainforest with collapsing ruins, bioluminescent fungi, and unpredictable environmental hazards. The air is thick with humidity, and the sounds of unseen creatures echo chaotically.
level.player_weapon: Beastmaster's Totem: A mystical staff that channels primal energy to summon and control beasts.

enemy.name: Giant Viper
enemy.weakness: Poison damage (from player's blowgun darts).

encounters.hazard: Vines snap and fall unpredictably, creating obstacles.

pickup.name: Serpent Fang
pickup.effect: Ignites fire when thrown (can be used as a fire source).

encounters.trigger: Defeating the viper unlocks a hidden path through the thicket, leading to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Mutant Mangrove
enemy.weakness: Fire damage (using the Serpent Fang pickup).

encounters.hazard: Quicksand swallows the player, forcing them to avoid traps while fighting.

pickup.name: Burning Ember
pickup.effect: Boosts fire damage by 50% for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Mangrove causes a cave-in, revealing the path to the boss arena.

enemy.name: Jaguar Spirit (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Burning Ember pickup (must be activated during the boss's 'Feral Rage' phase).

encounters.hazard: Collapsing platforms and hallucinogenic mist that disorients the player.

pickup.name: Totem of the Jungle King
pickup.effect: Unlocks a permanent beast companion with high attack speed.

encounters.trigger: The boss awakens only after the Mangrove is destroyed, as its destruction disrupts the jungle's balance.

boss.name: Jaguar Spirit
boss.weakness: Burning Ember pickup (must be used during the boss's 'Feral Rage' phase to bypass its invulnerability).
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Jaguar Spirit using the Burning Ember to trigger a vulnerability window.

level.objective: Navigate the chaotic jungle, defeat three enemies, and harness pickups to weaken the final boss.
level.reward: Totem of the Jungle King (permanent companion) and access to the next level.

level.theme: The Veil of the Forgotten Temple
level.setting: A mist-shrouded jungle with ancient stone ruins, bioluminescent fungi, and overgrown pathways. Strange whispers echo through the trees, and the air hums with unseen energy.
level.player_weapon: Composite Bow (can fire silenced arrows or fire arrows with pickups)

enemy.name: Shadow Jaguar
enemy.weakness: Silenced arrows (player's weapon)

encounters.hazard: Stealthy ambush; triggers traps if noise is made.

pickup.name: Silenced Arrow Quiver
pickup.effect: Allows silent shots, bypassing enemy traps.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Shadow Jaguar, the altar's stone shifts, revealing a hidden path to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Stone Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Fire arrows (requires pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Guardian of a sealed gate; activates seismic traps if attacked normally.

pickup.name: Ancient Relic Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the boss chamber's energy barrier.

encounters.trigger: After destroying the Stone Sentinel, the courtyard's gate opens, revealing a glowing path to the boss fight.

encounters.location: Boss Chamber: Heart of the Temple

enemy.name: Spirit of the Forgotten
enemy.weakness: Ancient Relic Key (specific pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The spirit summons spectral vines and manipulates the environment.

pickup.name: Echo Crystal
pickup.effect: Unlocks a hidden jungle zone; grants permanent +10 damage with bows.

encounters.trigger: The Ancient Relic Key weakens the spirit's barrier, allowing the player to strike its core.

boss.name: Spirit of the Forgotten
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the spirit's core by targeting its glowing eye with the Ancient Relic Key.

level.objective: Survive the temple's trials and defeat the spirit to reclaim the Echo Crystal.
level.reward: Echo Crystal (permanent stat boost), map to a hidden jungle zone.

level.setting: A dense, mist-shrouded rainforest with ancient ruins overgrown by vegetation. The air is thick with humidity, and the sounds of unseen predators echo through the canopy.
level.player_weapon: Silenced pistol (initial weapon) and a vial of venom (pickup from first encounter).

enemy.name: Silent Jaguar
enemy.weakness: Silenced pistol (no noise) or venom (poison damage)

encounters.hazard: Thick vines block the path; the jaguar is guarding a hidden shrine.

pickup.name: Vial of Venom
pickup.effect: Applies poison damage over time (50% damage per tick for 3 ticks) when used on enemies.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the jaguar triggers a hidden pressure plate, causing a stone door to open, revealing the path to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Stone Shaman
enemy.weakness: Vial of Venom (corrodes the shaman's enchanted armor)

encounters.hazard: The shaman has erected traps (collapsing vines, dart traps) that activate if the player is not stealthy.

pickup.name: Jungle Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks a sealed door leading to the boss chamber.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the shaman's armor with the venom vial reveals a hidden switch that raises a bridge to the final area.

enemy.name: The Rootbound Colossus
enemy.weakness: Jungle Key (disrupts the colossus's root-based regeneration)

encounters.hazard: The colossus is surrounded by a magical barrier that can only be broken by the Jungle Key. It summons smaller root spirits during the fight.

pickup.name: Ancient Jungle Relic
pickup.effect: Grants temporary invincibility (3 seconds) when activated.

encounters.trigger: The player must use the Jungle Key to break the barrier, which also alerts the colossus to initiate the boss fight.

boss.name: The Rootbound Colossus
boss.weakness: Jungle Key (disrupts the colossus's root-based regeneration)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the colossus by exploiting the Jungle Key's effect while managing damage from root spirits.

level.objective: Navigate the jungle, defeat the three enemies to obtain the Jungle Key, and use it to defeat the final boss.
level.reward: Ancient Jungle Relic (temporary invincibility) and access to the next level.

level.setting: A lush, tranquil jungle with emerald foliage, a meandering river, and glowing bioluminescent flora. The air hums with birdcalls and distant waterfalls.

enemy.name: Jaguar Ambush
enemy.weakness: Ironwood Spear (player's starting weapon)

encounters.hazard: Thick vines block the path forward until the jaguar is defeated.

pickup.name: Bramble Shield
pickup.effect: Deals +5 damage to plant-based enemies when used in combat.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the jaguar causes the vines to retract, revealing a hidden trail leading to the next area.

enemy.name: Vine Strangler
enemy.weakness: Bramble Shield (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Living vines attack the player, constricting movement.

pickup.name: Soothing Herb
pickup.effect: Reduces boss's damage by 30% when used during the final fight.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Vine Strangler with the Bramble Shield unlocks a stone tablet that glows, indicating the path to the boss's lair.

enemy.name: Spirit of the Corrupted Grove
enemy.weakness: Soothing Herb (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The spirit manifests as a swirling mist that damages the player over time.

pickup.name: Eternal Guardian Token
pickup.effect: Unlocks a permanent +10 defense boost for the player.

encounters.trigger: The glowing stone tablet from the prior encounter activates, summoning the spirit. The Soothing Herb must be used to weaken it before it can be defeated.

boss.name: Spirit of the Corrupted Grove
boss.victory_condition: Apply the Soothing Herb to reduce the boss's damage output, then defeat it with the Ironwood Spear and Bramble Shield.

level.objective: Restore balance to the jungle by defeating the corrupted spirit and retrieving the Eternal Guardian Token.
level.reward: Eternal Guardian Token (permanent defense boost) and a serene, restored jungle environment.

level.setting: A dense, mist-shrouded jungle with ancient ruins and bioluminescent flora. The air hums with eerie whispers, and the undergrowth pulses with malevolent energy. The player’s necromantic magic agitates the land, summoning cursed entities.

enemy.name: Shadow Jaguar
enemy.weakness: Curse Aura (player's Bone Staff)

encounters.hazard: The jaguar’s shadow mimics the player’s movements, luring them into traps.

pickup.name: Tribal Amulet
pickup.effect: Disrupts enemy magic; grants +15% magic resistance.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the jaguar causes the mist to part, revealing a hidden path to the cursed village.

enemy.name: Cursed Shaman
enemy.weakness: Tribal Amulet (from prior pickup)

encounters.hazard: The shaman summons spectral totems that deal AoE damage when the amulet is unused.

pickup.name: Jungle Root
pickup.effect: Poisons enemies on contact; applies 30% damage over 5 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the shaman’s totems with the Tribal Amulet activates a hidden lever, triggering the boss fight.

enemy.name: Jungle Titan (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Jungle Root (from prior pickup)

encounters.hazard: The titan’s body is composed of living vines; attacks regenerate 5% health per second.

pickup.name: Soul of the Jungle
pickup.effect: Unlocks necromancer ability: 'Root Grasp' (grants 25% chance to stun enemies).

encounters.trigger: The lever pulled in the village causes the temple’s vines to writhe, summoning the titan.

boss.name: Jungle Titan
boss.weakness: Jungle Root (must be applied manually to degrade the titan’s armor).
boss.victory_condition: Apply Jungle Root to the titan’s core, then strike with the Bone Staff to trigger a fatal collapse.

level.objective: Navigate the haunted jungle, defeat three cursed entities, and destroy the Jungle Titan by leveraging pickups from prior encounters.
level.reward: Soul of the Jungle (unlocks a new necromancer ability)

level.setting: A vibrant, enchanted jungle with floating flower islands, talking parrots, and bioluminescent plants. The air hums with magical energy, and the ground shifts subtly as if alive.

enemy.name: Giggling Gibbon
enemy.weakness: Basic alchemical flame (player's starting weapon)

encounters.hazard: Mischievous Gibbon throws fruit that temporarily slows the player.

pickup.name: Bramble Seed
pickup.effect: Catalyst for fire-based potions (increases fire damage by 20%)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Gibbon causes a hidden path to open, revealing a glowing vine that leads to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Vine Vortex
enemy.weakness: Fire-based potion (requires Bramble Seed from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The Vine Vortex entangles the player, reducing movement speed by 50% for 5 seconds.

pickup.name: Serpent's Scale
pickup.effect: Alchemical catalyst for a potent poison (deals 30 damage over 3 seconds)

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Vine Vortex causes the jungle to tremble, revealing a hidden temple entrance guarded by the final boss.

enemy.name: Ancient Rootwrath
enemy.weakness: Poison potion crafted with Serpent's Scale (from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The boss summons protective roots that regenerate 10% health every 3 seconds.

pickup.name: Jungle Heart
pickup.effect: Restores 50% player health and grants temporary invincibility for 5 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating the boss unlocks the jungle's secret: a hidden grove where the player can craft legendary alchemical items.

boss.name: Ancient Rootwrath
boss.weakness: Poison potion (requires Serpent's Scale from Encounter 2)
boss.victory_condition: Reduce health to 0 using poison damage

level.objective: Navigate the jungle, defeat whimsical enemies, and uncover the secret of the Rootwrath Temple.
level.reward: Jungle Heart (healing item) and access to a new alchemical recipe.

level.setting: A dense, mist-shrouded jungle filled with ancient stone ruins and flickering auroras. The air hums with distorted echoes of the past, and trees twist into impossible shapes. Shadows move independently, and the player’s watch ticks backward intermittently.
level.player_weapon: Chrono-Blade (a sword that slices through time, leaving afterimages and disrupting temporal fields)

enemy.name: Temporal Jaguar
enemy.weakness: Chrono-Blade’s time disruption ability (slashing through its temporal armor)

encounters.hazard: The ground shifts between past and present, forcing the player to navigate unstable terrain.

pickup.name: Time Crystal
pickup.effect: Restores 30% of the player’s health and temporarily stabilizes local time for 15 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Jaguar unlocks the path to the 'Echoing Temple' by shattering a temporal barrier with the Chrono-Blade.

enemy.name: Shadow Hunter
enemy.weakness: Time Crystal’s energy (overloads its shadow-based form, causing temporal feedback)

encounters.hazard: The temple is filled with mirrored surfaces that duplicate the player’s movements, creating confusion.

pickup.name: Time Anchor
pickup.effect: Freezes enemies in time for 5 seconds (can be charged with energy from the Time Crystal).

encounters.trigger: The Shadow Hunter’s defeat reveals a hidden chamber with the Time Anchor, which is needed to access the final area.

encounters.location: The Heart of the Temporal Rift

enemy.name: Chrono-Serpent (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Time Anchor’s stabilization (nullifies the boss’s time-based attacks and reveals its physical core)

encounters.hazard: The battlefield shifts between eras, with collapsing ruins and phantom versions of the player’s past self.

pickup.name: Eternal Core
pickup.effect: Permanently increases the Chrono-Blade’s damage by 20% and grants immunity to time-based debuffs.

encounters.trigger: Using the Time Anchor during the boss fight unlocks the Eternal Core, restoring balance to the jungle’s timeline.

boss.name: Chrono-Serpent
boss.weakness: Time Anchor (required to counter its temporal attacks)
boss.victory_condition: Use the Time Anchor to freeze the boss, then strike its core with the Chrono-Blade.

level.objective: Restore balance to the jungle’s timeline by defeating the Chrono-Serpent and reclaiming the Eternal Core.
level.reward: Eternal Core (enhances the Chrono-Blade and grants time manipulation mastery).

level.setting: A crumbling, overgrown rainforest with dead trees, fog-shrouded ruins, and a pervasive sense of abandonment. The air is thick with decay and the distant calls of unseen predators.
level.player_weapon: Jagged Machete (initial weapon, upgrades with pickups)

enemy.name: Jaguar Phantom
enemy.weakness: Bladed attacks (player's initial Jagged Machete). The phantom's brittle bone armor cracks under sharp force.

encounters.hazard: Toxic Fumes (reduces player health by 10% over 30 seconds)

pickup.name: Vine Fiber
pickup.effect: Crafts a piercing weapon or trap, increasing damage by 20% against armored foes.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Jaguar Phantom removes the toxic fumes, revealing a path through the tangled vines leading to the next area.

enemy.name: Mire Stalker
enemy.weakness: Piercing attacks (Vine Fiber from prior encounter). The stalker's thick hide is vulnerable to sharp, concentrated force.

encounters.hazard: Quicksand Pits (trap player in 50% damage over 15 seconds)

pickup.name: Rage Core
pickup.effect: Boosts berserker rage generation by 50%, allowing for longer periods of invincibility and increased damage.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Mire Stalker causes the swamp to drain, revealing a stone staircase leading to the canopy temple where the final boss awaits.

boss.name: Canopy Warden
boss.weakness: Energy bursts from the Rage Core (pickup from second encounter). The warden's shield is impervious to physical attacks but vulnerable to concentrated energy surges.
boss.victory_condition: Use the Rage Core to trigger a damaging energy burst during the boss's shielded phase.

level.objective: Survive the brutal jungle encounters, acquire pickups to weaken enemies, and defeat the Canopy Warden with the Rage Core.
level.reward: Ancient Berserker Relic (unlocks a permanent rage regeneration ability)
